## Authenticated exercise observed

The actual helper journal records `exercise_complete` at 2026-09-16T07:04:48Z and a passed attempt at 07:04:49Z: **22 application POSTs, all created Auth sessions closed**. The reviewer checked the journal chain and inspected the actual outcomes. All expected statuses match, including contributor/member review403, member vehicle-save403 and signed-out vehicle-save401. Four retained roster versions and three reports are present, with14 fleet download/proof fingerprints.

The reviewer inspected report snapshots: version2 has two matched/reviewed vehicles; version3 retains `workpaper_review_required` and `roster_review_required`, a null roster review and the missing workpaper review; version4 returns to two matched/reviewed vehicles after separate acceptance. Every snapshot has null emissions totals, incomplete Scope1/corporate coverage and `releaseEligible: false`. The final exercise journal event hash is `61310243aa08d2591d39952496662b789af855fdfa3ed374a4789d286b89be0f` (event hash, not whole-file hash).

The reviewer independently ran the actual corporate/mobile/fleet decoders on the retained exercise registers; all passed. Exact earlier coverage/mobile versions and reports, plus all prior coverage/mobile/gas download fingerprints, were compared to the recorded baseline and preserved.

The revisit started afterward and finished at 07:14:04.565Z with **zero application POSTs and all created Auth sessions closed**. There are no POST journal events in the revisit segment. Its verification event binds the exact completed exercise event, whose register/download equality checks run through the reviewed helper.

The final58-event journal chain was independently rebuilt and verified. Whole-file SHA256: `a230f18e1b6f596a3ba4aaee5cf16e2d27fdbb26786326a62f98a35636816347`; final event hash: `8765dc35003d8c5e2df6fc4303d04b31294ea2f14a3fa061c1865d4b50f4ea65`.
